meanrev.evidence_prior: Connors RSI(2)/z-score long-only on index ETFs above 200-SMA: historically 60-70% win, ~10-35bps/trade net post-2018 decay. Tight stops demonstrably hurt this class - the 200-SMA filter IS the risk control; stop_pct is a disaster stop only.

tom.evidence_prior: Turn-of-the-month on S&P: last ~2 trading days through first ~3 of next month. Only calendar effect still statistically significant in 1980-2024 samples; ~65% win, honest 20-50bps net per monthly window. 12 events/yr - runs on the 45-year prior, not on live sample.

btctrend.evidence_prior: BTC slow trend, long/flat, weekly banded (enter: 20d breakout AND >100-SMA; exit: <100-SMA AND <40-SMA): only crypto strategy clearing Robinhood's ~100bps round-trip spread. OOS-validated 2022-2024 (Quantpedia MAX/breakout; Grayscale MA-cross; Zarattini et al. net-of-fees). 3-8 RT/yr; payoff is drawdown truncation more than alpha. Sized by stress-day math: BTC can drop 15-20% in a day, so max sleeve 15% of account. live_alloc=0 is deliberate - crypto execution not built and account not crypto-enabled; paper measures until both exist. Paper models the FULL 100bps spread so measured expectancy is net of the real toll.

graduation.note: Paper phase proves IMPLEMENTATION (rule compliance, slippage vs model), not edge - a 20bps edge is statistically undetectable at retail N. Graduate when: enough events to trust the plumbing, expectancy not deeply negative (bug detector), and the strategy has a documented evidence_prior. Live sizing then assumes edge ~= prior, risk sized as if edge = 0.
